simple.prompt: Look at those dark skies; it ___ rain this afternoon.
simple.explanation: Modal might menyatakan kemungkinan masa depan yang tentatif (uncertain possibility).

simple.prompt: He isn't in his office; he ___ be in the conference hall.
simple.explanation: May be menyatakan kemungkinan spekulasi saat ini (present possibility).

simple.targetSentence: This proposal could solve our problem.
simple.explanation: Subject + could + base verb (solve) + our problem.

simple.prompt: She has been working for 14 hours straight; she ___ be exhausted.
simple.explanation: Must digunakan untuk deduksi kepastian logis kuat (strong logical deduction).
hints: Deduksi logis pasti setelah 14 jam bekerja.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi negatif dengan can't be.
simple.explanation: Deduksi ketidakmungkinan logis: can't be true.

simple.prompt: Where are my keys? — They ___ be in your coat pocket.
simple.explanation: Might be menyatakan kemungkinan tebakan yang masuk akal.

simple.targetSentence: We may not receive the delivery today.
simple.explanation: Subject + may not + base verb (receive) + the delivery today.

simple.prompt: The lights in the meeting room are on, so the team ___ be inside right now.
simple.explanation: Keyakinan logis yang sangat kuat (~95-100% yakin) berdasarkan bukti nyata ('the lights are on') memakai 'must + V1'.
hints: Ada bukti jelas lampu ruang rapat menyala.

simple.prompt: That signature ___ be Maya's — she left for Singapore yesterday morning!
simple.explanation: Untuk menyatakan sesuatu PASTI TIDAK MUNGKIN secara logis (~0% mungkin), bahasa Inggris memakai 'can't' (BUKAN 'mustn't'!).
hints: Lawan logis dari deduksi 'must be' bukanlah 'mustn't be'.

simple.prompt: Where is the courier? — I am not certain, yet he ___ be stuck in downtown traffic.
simple.explanation: Kemungkinan yang belum pasti (~30-50%, 'I am not certain') dinyatakan dengan 'might', 'may', atau 'could'.
hints: Pembicara berkata 'I am not certain' (tidak yakin).

simple.prompt: Even with a good backup plan, shipping delays ___ still happen during monsoon season.
simple.explanation: Menyatakan kemungkinan umum yang masuk akal menggunakan 'could' atau 'may/might'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di meja kantor tentang kemungkinan ketidakhadiran.
dialogue: Supervisor
Is Kevin coming to the product tasting?
Assistant
He ___ attend because he has a dental appointment at four.
simple.explanation: Menyatakan kemungkinan negatif ('mungkin tidak hadir') menggunakan 'may not' atau 'might not' (bukan 'can't' jika tidak 100% mustahil).
hints: Belum pasti 100%, melainkan kemungkinan tidak ikut.
Kemungkinan negatif memakai 'may not' atau 'might not'.

simple.prompt: You have been driving for eight hours straight; you ___ feel exhausted!
simple.explanation: Deduksi logis yang wajar dan hampir pasti benar dari kelelahan menyetir 8 jam memakai 'must'.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan umum memakai 'mustn't' untuk kesimpulan logis negatif berikut.
simple.draft: That blurry profile photo mustn't be our new CEO; our CEO is much taller.
options: That blurry profile photo can't be our new CEO; our CEO is much taller.
That blurry profile photo doesn't must be our new CEO; our CEO is much taller.
That blurry profile photo shouldn't be our new CEO; our CEO is much taller.
simple.explanation: 'Mustn't' hanya dipakai untuk larangan ('dilarang'), BUKAN deduksi logis mustahil; lawan dari deduksi 'must be' adalah 'can't be'.
hints: 'Mustn't' berarti larangan aturan, bukan kesimpulan logika.

simple.prompt: Don't call the branch now; at 9 p.m., they ___ be closed already.
simple.explanation: Menebak kemungkinan yang cukup masuk akal namun belum dicek pasti memakai 'might/may/could'.
hints: Masih perkiraan situasi di jam 9 malam.

simple.targetSentence: The missing HDMI adapter could be inside the blue camera bag.
simple.explanation: Modal kemungkinan 'could' langsung diikuti bentuk dasar 'be' + keterangan tempat.
hints: Awali dengan 'The missing HDMI adapter could be'.
Tambahkan lokasi 'inside the blue camera bag'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat kesimpulan logis negatif memakai 'can't'.
simple.targetSentence: This invoice can't be accurate because the tax rate doubled.
simple.explanation: Subjek + can't be + adjective + klausa alasan 'because...'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'This invoice can't be accurate'.

dialogue: Colleague
Is that the CEO walking across the parking lot?
Assistant
No, it ___ be her; she is attending a conference in Tokyo this week.
intermediate.explanation: Deduksi kemustahilan logis (pasti mustahil bukan dia): can't be her.
hints: Mustahil karena orangnya sedang di Tokyo.

intermediate.prompt: Why is the client hesitating? — They ___ waiting for board approval.
intermediate.explanation: Might be + verb-ing menyatakan kemungkinan spekulatif untuk aksi yang sedang berlangsung.

intermediate.prompt: The lights in his study are still on; he ___ working late.
intermediate.explanation: Bukti fisik lampu menyala mendukung kesimpulan logis pasti: must be working late.
hints: Lampu menyala adalah bukti pendukung kuat.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat kemungkinan negatif dengan might not.
intermediate.targetSentence: The flight might not depart on time due to fog.
intermediate.explanation: The flight + might not + base verb (depart) + on time due to fog.
hints: Mulai dengan The flight might not.

intermediate.prompt: He has a thick Scottish accent; he ___ from Edinburgh.
intermediate.explanation: Deduksi kuat berdasarkan ciri aksen: must be from Edinburgh.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat kemungkinan alternatif dengan could be.
intermediate.targetSentence: The discrepancy could be an accounting error.
intermediate.explanation: Subject + could be + noun phrase (an accounting error).
hints: Mulai dengan The discrepancy could be.

dialogue: Auditor
Are we confident in these revenue projections?
Finance Lead
They are plausible, but market volatility ___ affect the bottom line.
intermediate.explanation: Could menyatakan potensi risiko kemungkinan masa depan.

intermediate.prompt: Listen — do you hear clicking upstairs? The IT intern ___ be fixing the ceiling router right now.
intermediate.explanation: Deduksi atau kemungkinan tentang aksi yang sedang berlangsung saat ini menggunakan pola Modal Continuous: 'might/must + be + V-ing'.
hints: Berdasarkan suara klik di atas, ia mungkin sedang memperbaiki router.

intermediate.prompt: She didn't answer my text immediately — she ___ be driving on the toll road right now.
intermediate.explanation: Menebak dengan yakin apa yang sedang dilakukan seseorang saat ini memakai 'must be + V-ing'.
hints: Kesimpulan masuk akal tentang aktivitas sedang berlangsung.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang dugaan kejadian di masa lampau.
dialogue: Manager
Why was the warehouse back door unlocked this morning?
Guard
The night delivery crew ___ forgotten to latch it before driving off.
intermediate.explanation: Deduksi pasti tentang peristiwa MASA LAMPAU memakai Modal Perfect: 'must have + V3 (forgotten)'.
hints: Ada V3 'forgotten' dan kejadiannya tadi malam/pagi.
Modal deduksi masa lalu memakai 'modal + have + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Wait — he ___ missed the announcement; I sent it directly to his personal phone AND pinned it to Slack!
intermediate.explanation: Menyatakan ketidakmungkinan logis atas kejadian di masa lampau memakai 'can't have + V3' atau 'couldn't have + V3'.
hints: Ada dua bukti pengiriman langsung, jadi mustahil dia melewatkannya.
Ketidakmungkinan masa lampau memakai 'couldn't/can't have + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Notice the difference between 'couldn't' and 'might not': 'The parcel didn't arrive — the courier ___ found our new side entrance yet.'
intermediate.explanation: Jika belum yakin 100% penyebabnya di masa lalu ('mungkin belum menemukan'), gunakan 'might not have + V3' (bukan 'couldn't have' yang berarti 100% mustahil).
hints: Maknanya kemungkinan negatif ('mungkin tidak menemukan'), bukan mustahil.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan bentuk modal perfect tanpa 'have' pada kalimat dugaan lampau berikut.
intermediate.draft: Judging by the wet pavement outside, it must rained heavily during the night.
options: Judging by the wet pavement outside, it must have rained heavily during the night.
Judging by the wet pavement outside, it must been raining heavily during the night.
Judging by the wet pavement outside, it must raining heavily during the night.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk membuat deduksi masa lampau dari modal ('must', 'might', 'can't'), jangan langsung tempel V2; wajib sisipkan 'have' sebelum V3 ('must have rained').

intermediate.prompt: You ___ be serious about hiking four hours in dress shoes!
intermediate.explanation: Ungkapan ketidakpercayaan saat mendengar sesuatu yang tidak masuk akal saat ini adalah 'You can't be serious!'.

intermediate.prompt: Why isn't Farhan at his workstation? — He ___ be taking a short coffee break downstairs.
intermediate.explanation: Sebagai catatan penting: untuk kemungkinan spesifik sekarang/akan datang, gunakan 'may/might/could', BUKAN 'can' dalam kalimat positif! ('He can be taking' salah).
hints: 'Can' tidak dipakai untuk menebak kemungkinan kasus spesifik saat ini.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi aktivitas yang sedang berjalan sekarang.
intermediate.targetSentence: The external auditors must be reviewing our tax receipts in Room B right now.
intermediate.explanation: Pola 'must be + V-ing' menyimpulkan aksi yang diyakini sedang berlangsung sekarang.
hints: Awali dengan 'The external auditors must be reviewing'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat kemungkinan lampau dengan 'may have + V3'.
intermediate.targetSentence: A loose power cable may have caused the brief server outage.
intermediate.explanation: Modal kemungkinan masa lalu memakai 'may have + V3 (caused)'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'A loose power cable may have caused'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan deduksi masa lalu yang keliru menggunakan present modal.
complex.draft: The team was celebrating yesterday; they must win the championship.
options: The team was celebrating yesterday; they must have won the championship.
The team was celebrating yesterday; they had to win the championship.
The team was celebrating yesterday; they must had won the championship.
complex.explanation: Deduksi logis masa lampau (past logical deduction) WAJIB menggunakan modal perfect: must have + V3 (must have won).

complex.prompt: The server crash ___ prevented if the redundancy protocol had been triggered.
complex.explanation: Kemampuan atau kemungkinan pasif di masa lampau yang tidak terwujud: could have been prevented.

complex.prompt: You ___ seen Sarah in New York yesterday; she was having dinner with me in London!
complex.explanation: Deduksi kemustahilan logis masa lampau (past impossibility): can't have + V3 (can't have seen).
hints: Mustahil karena orangnya ada di London kemarin.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi negatif masa lampau.
complex.targetSentence: He can't have stolen the documents.
complex.explanation: Subject + can't have + past participle (stolen) + the documents.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan antara might have dan should have pada penyesalan.
complex.draft: I didn't hear the alarm, so I might have missed the meeting.
options: I didn't hear the alarm, so I might miss the meeting.
I didn't hear the alarm, which is why I missed the meeting.
I didn't hear the alarm, so I may have missed the meeting.
complex.explanation: Klausa sebab-akibat fakta riil lampau (real past fact) tidak memerlukan modal spekulasi jika peristiwanya sudah pasti terjadi.
hints: Fakta riil bahwa pertemuan sudah terlewatkan.

complex.prompt: The ancient parchment ___ date back to the fourteenth century, according to recent radiocarbon testing.
complex.explanation: Idiom 'may well / could well' digunakan untuk menyatakan probabilitas kuat yang sangat mungkin benar.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog investigasi forensik dengan modal perfect.
dialogue: Detective
How did the intruder bypass the biometric gate?
Forensic Lead
The intruder ___ had inside assistance from an employee.
complex.explanation: Spekulasi kemungkinan masa lampau: might have + V3 (might have had).

complex.prompt: Compare carefully: 'The train ___ be here soon; it left the previous station ten minutes ago' (logical expectation based on normal timing) vs 'He ___ have taken the shortcut' (pure speculation).
complex.explanation: 'Should' juga berfungsi sebagai modal deduksi ekspektasi/probabilitas wajar (~80%: 'seharusnya sudah hampir tiba menurut jadwal'), sedangkan tebakan terbuka memakai 'might'.
hints: Kalimat pertama menyatakan ekspektasi logis berdasarkan jadwal.
'Should' menyatakan probabilitas yang wajar diharapkan terjadi.

complex.prompt: Even if we had launched earlier, consumers ___ still have hesitated to adopt the new format.
complex.explanation: Dalam Third/Mixed Conditional spekulatif, 'might have + V3' menyatakan kemungkinan hasil alternatif masa lampau yang lebih lemah daripada 'would have'.
hints: Perhatikan struktur modal spekulatif lampau '... have hesitated'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan modal 'can' untuk spekulasi masa depan tunggal berikut.
complex.draft: Given tomorrow's forecast, heavy coastal winds can delay the morning cargo vessel.
options: Given tomorrow's forecast, heavy coastal winds could delay the morning cargo vessel.
Given tomorrow's forecast, heavy coastal winds mustn't delay the morning cargo vessel.
Given tomorrow's forecast, heavy coastal winds can have delayed the morning cargo vessel.
complex.explanation: Untuk prediksi kemungkinan masa depan pada kejadian spesifik ('tomorrow's cargo vessel'), 'can' tidak dipakai dalam kalimat positif — gunakan 'could', 'may', atau 'might'.
hints: 'Can' hanya untuk kemampuan atau kemungkinan teoretis umum, bukan prediksi kejadian tunggal esok hari.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan teknis tentang deduksi kontinu di masa lampau.
dialogue: Lead
Why did the battery drain overnight while the laptop sat in sleep mode?
Engineer
A background indexing task ___ running silently all night.
complex.explanation: Menyimpulkan aktivitas yang kemungkinan/pasti sedang berlangsung di masa lampau memakai Modal Perfect Continuous: 'must have been + V-ing'.
hints: Aktivitas terjadi di masa lalu ('overnight') dan berlangsung terus ('running all night').

complex.prompt: Contrast epistemic certainty vs counterfactual past risk: 'Watch out — that cracked ladder ___ have collapsed under two people!' (luckily it didn't).
complex.explanation: 'Could have + V3' sering mengungkapkan bahaya/kejadian masa lalu yang BERPOTENSI terjadi namun untungnya tidak terjadi ('nyaris saja roboh').
hints: Maknanya 'tadi bisa saja roboh kalau dinaiki dua orang'.
Risiko lampau yang nyaris terjadi memakai 'could have + V3'.

complex.prompt: Well, we ___ as well review the backup slides now since the client asked for a ten-minute break.
complex.explanation: Idiom tetap 'may/might as well + V1' digunakan ketika tidak ada pilihan yang lebih baik dalam situasi saat ini ('sekalian saja kita...').
hints: Cari kata yang tepat untuk idiom '... as well review'.
'May as well' / 'Might as well' berarti sekalian saja.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menyatukan dua modal atau 'had' di dalam deduksi lampau berikut.
complex.draft: The missing courier must hadn't seen our bright loading bay sign in the rain.
options: The missing courier must not have seen our bright loading bay sign in the rain.
The missing courier mustn't hadn't seen our bright loading bay sign in the rain.
The missing courier can't hadn't seen our bright loading bay sign in the rain.
complex.explanation: Bentuk negatif deduksi masa lampau dari 'must have seen' adalah 'must not have seen' (atau 'couldn't/can't have seen' untuk mustahil), bukan 'must hadn't'.
hints: Pakai 'must not have + V3' (atau 'couldn't have + V3').

complex.prompt: No matter what shortcuts they tried, the old bridge ___ possibly have carried a forty-ton truck safely.
complex.explanation: Untuk menekankan ketidakmungkinan mutlak di masa lampau dengan penegas 'possibly', bahasa Inggris baku memakai 'couldn't possibly have + V3'.
hints: Penegas 'possibly' sangat sering mendampingi 'couldn't' untuk mustahil total.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat deduksi berkelanjutan masa lalu memakai 'might have been'.
complex.targetSentence: The customer might have been waiting on the wrong floor for twenty minutes.
complex.explanation: Pola 'might have been + V-ing' menduga aktivitas berdurasi yang terjadi di masa lampau.
hints: Awali dengan 'The customer might have been waiting'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat ekspektasi logis di masa depan memakai 'should'.
complex.targetSentence: According to the courier tracker, our spare parts should arrive before lunch.
complex.explanation: 'Should + V1' mengekspresikan keyakinan/harapan wajar berdasarkan data pelacak.
hints: Mulai dengan 'According to the courier tracker,'.
Tambahkan 'our spare parts should arrive before lunch'.
